accepted_findings.claim: varnames can strip an implicit self argument from a bound method even when its qualname has no dot.

evidence_receipt.claim: varnames can strip an implicit self argument from a bound method even when its qualname has no dot.
evidence_receipt.falsification_condition: If the code only checked for a dot in qualname and not is_bound, it would not strip self from bound methods with no dot in qualname. However, the patch adds 'if is_bound or "." in qualname', so self is stripped for bound methods regardless of qualname containing a dot.
